draft.subject: consent and AI tools
draft.body:
Hi Euan,

A different angle. ABA Formal Opinion 512 says a lawyer needs the client's informed consent before putting client information into a self-learning generative AI tool.

Is client consent something Carrick Dunn has had to think about?

claims.text: ABA Formal Opinion 512 says a lawyer needs the client's informed consent before putting client information into a self-learning generative AI tool

evidence.text: Practice Innovation Lead. Help our lawyers adopt AI and automation safely across the private client team.

facts.wording: Built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture (Legal AI).
The Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) warning notice of 17 August 2026 allows client data into AI tools only with contractual, technical and organisational safeguards.
A 17+ person team of engineers, AI specialists and analysts, based in San Jose.
